AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: ECS Fargate cluster with two microservices behind an internal Network Load Balancer

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first public subnet
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second public subnet
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet
  ServiceAImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/ecs-samples/amazon-ecs-sample:latest
    Description: Container image for Service A
  ServiceBImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/ecs-samples/amazon-ecs-sample:latest
    Description: Container image for Service B
  ServiceAPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
    Description: Listener and container port for Service A
  ServiceBPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 9090
    Description: Listener and container port for Service B
  ServiceADesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Desired task count for Service A
  ServiceBDesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Desired task count for Service B
  TaskCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues:
      - 256
      - 512
      - 1024
      - 2048
    Description: Fargate task CPU (valid values 256,512,1024,2048)
  TaskMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1024
    AllowedValues:
      - 512
      - 1024
      - 2048
      - 3072
      - 4096
      - 5120
      - 6144
      - 7168
      - 8192
    Description: Fargate task memory in MiB (ensure compatible with CPU)
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention in days

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-az1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-az2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-az1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-az2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az2'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-az1'

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-az2'

  PrivateRoute1Default:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2Default:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'
      Configuration:
        ExecuteCommandConfiguration:
          Logging: DEFAULT
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'

  ECSServiceExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-exec-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-exec-role'

  ECSTaskRoleA:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-task-role-a'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-task-role-a'

  ECSTaskRoleB:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-task-role-b'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-task-role-b'

  ServiceALogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${AWS::StackName}/service-a'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  ServiceBLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${AWS::StackName}/service-b'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  ServiceATaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-a'
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSServiceExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRoleA.Arn
      RuntimePlatform:
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-a
          Image: !Ref ServiceAImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceALogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service
          Environment:
            - Name: SERVICE_NAME
              Value: service-a

  ServiceBTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-b'
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSServiceExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRoleB.Arn
      RuntimePlatform:
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-b
          Image: !Ref ServiceBImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceBLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service
          Environment:
            - Name: SERVICE_NAME
              Value: service-b

  ServiceASecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service A tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg-service-a'

  ServiceBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service B tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg-service-b'

  InternalNLB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Scheme: internal
      Type: network
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled
          Value: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nlb-internal'

  TargetGroupA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: TCP
      Port: !Ref ServiceAPort
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '30'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tg-a'

  TargetGroupB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: TCP
      Port: !Ref ServiceBPort
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '30'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tg-b'

  NLBListenerA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref InternalNLB
      Port: !Ref ServiceAPort
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupA

  NLBListenerB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref InternalNLB
      Port: !Ref ServiceBPort
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupB

  ECSServiceA:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - NLBListenerA
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-a'
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      DesiredCount: !Ref ServiceADesiredCount
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: TASK_DEFINITION
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupA
          ContainerName: service-a
          ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceASecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-a'

  ECSServiceB:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - NLBListenerB
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-b'
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      DesiredCount: !Ref ServiceBDesiredCount
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: TASK_DEFINITION
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupB
          ContainerName: service-b
          ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceBSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-b'

Outputs:
  ClusterArn:
    Description: ECS Cluster ARN
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ServiceAName:
    Description: ECS Service A name
    Value: !GetAtt ECSServiceA.Name
  ServiceBName:
    Description: ECS Service B name
    Value: !GetAtt ECSServiceB.Name
  InternalNLBDNSName:
    Description: Internal NLB DNS name (resolvable within the VPC)
    Value: !GetAtt InternalNLB.DNSName
  TargetGroupAArn:
    Description: Target Group A ARN
    Value: !Ref TargetGroupA
  TargetGroupBArn:
    Description: Target Group B ARN
    Value: !Ref TargetGroupB

  ServiceALogGroup:

    Properties:

  ServiceBLogGroup:

  ServiceATaskDefinition:

      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu

      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSServiceExecutionRole.Arn

      RuntimePlatform:
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-a

          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceALogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region

            - Name: SERVICE_NAME
              Value: service-a

  ServiceBTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-b'
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSServiceExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRoleB.Arn
      RuntimePlatform:
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-b
          Image: !Ref ServiceBImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceBLogGroup

  ServiceASecurityGroup:

      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg-service-a'

  ServiceBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service B tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp

          ToPort: !Ref ServiceBPort

        - Key: Name

  InternalNLB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:

      Type: network
      Subnets:

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:

          Value: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

  TargetGroupA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: TCP
      Port: !Ref ServiceAPort
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds

  TargetGroupB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup

  NLBListenerA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener

        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: TASK_DEFINITION

            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  ECSServiceB:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - NLBListenerB
    Properties:

      PlatformVersion: LATEST

  ServiceBName:

    Value: !GetAtt ECSServiceB.Name

message.content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: ECS Fargate cluster with two microservices behind an internal Network Load Balancer

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first public subnet
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second public subnet
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet
  ServiceAImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/ecs-samples/amazon-ecs-sample:latest
    Description: Container image for Service A
  ServiceBImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/ecs-samples/amazon-ecs-sample:latest
    Description: Container image for Service B
  ServiceAPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
    Description: Listener and container port for Service A
  ServiceBPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 9090
    Description: Listener and container port for Service B
  ServiceADesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Desired task count for Service A
  ServiceBDesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Desired task count for Service B
  TaskCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues:
      - 256
      - 512
      - 1024
      - 2048
    Description: Fargate task CPU (valid values 256,512,1024,2048)
  TaskMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1024
    AllowedValues:
      - 512
      - 1024
      - 2048
      - 3072
      - 4096
      - 5120
      - 6144
      - 7168
      - 8192
    Description: Fargate task memory in MiB (ensure compatible with CPU)
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention in days

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-az1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-az2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-az1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-az2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az2'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-az1'

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-az2'

  PrivateRoute1Default:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2Default:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'
      Configuration:
        ExecuteCommandConfiguration:
          Logging: DEFAULT
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'

  ECSServiceExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-exec-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-exec-role'

  ECSTaskRoleA:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-task-role-a'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-task-role-a'

  ECSTaskRoleB:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-task-role-b'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-task-role-b'

  ServiceALogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${AWS::StackName}/service-a'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  ServiceBLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${AWS::StackName}/service-b'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  ServiceATaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-a'
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSServiceExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRoleA.Arn
      RuntimePlatform:
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-a
          Image: !Ref ServiceAImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceALogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service
          Environment:
            - Name: SERVICE_NAME
              Value: service-a

  ServiceBTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-b'
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSServiceExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRoleB.Arn
      RuntimePlatform:
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-b
          Image: !Ref ServiceBImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceBLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service
          Environment:
            - Name: SERVICE_NAME
              Value: service-b

  ServiceASecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service A tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg-service-a'

  ServiceBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service B tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg-service-b'

  InternalNLB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Scheme: internal
      Type: network
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled
          Value: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nlb-internal'

  TargetGroupA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: TCP
      Port: !Ref ServiceAPort
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '30'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tg-a'

  TargetGroupB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: TCP
      Port: !Ref ServiceBPort
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '30'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tg-b'

  NLBListenerA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref InternalNLB
      Port: !Ref ServiceAPort
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupA

  NLBListenerB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref InternalNLB
      Port: !Ref ServiceBPort
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupB

  ECSServiceA:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - NLBListenerA
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-a'
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      DesiredCount: !Ref ServiceADesiredCount
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: TASK_DEFINITION
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupA
          ContainerName: service-a
          ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceASecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-a'

  ECSServiceB:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - NLBListenerB
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-b'
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      DesiredCount: !Ref ServiceBDesiredCount
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: TASK_DEFINITION
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupB
          ContainerName: service-b
          ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceBSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-b'

Outputs:
  ClusterArn:
    Description: ECS Cluster ARN
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ServiceAName:
    Description: ECS Service A name
    Value: !GetAtt ECSServiceA.Name
  ServiceBName:
    Description: ECS Service B name
    Value: !GetAtt ECSServiceB.Name
  InternalNLBDNSName:
    Description: Internal NLB DNS name (resolvable within the VPC)
    Value: !GetAtt InternalNLB.DNSName
  TargetGroupAArn:
    Description: Target Group A ARN
    Value: !Ref TargetGroupA
  TargetGroupBArn:
    Description: Target Group B ARN
    Value: !Ref TargetGroupB
